title: GitLab week 2 review - runners, stages, artifacts, needs
description: Eight questions on who runs a job, how it is isolated, and how files move between jobs.

questions.prompt: A runner is registered at the group level. Which projects' jobs can it take?

options.text: Only the project it was created from
Every project in the group and its subgroups

questions.explanation: Group runners serve the group's projects; instance runners serve everyone; project runners one project.

questions.prompt: Why does image: change nothing on a shell executor?

options.text: The shell executor runs jobs directly on the host, not in a container
image: is only read by Kubernetes
The shell executor pulls images lazily
It does - it changes the shell

questions.explanation: Only container-based executors (docker, kubernetes) use image:.

questions.prompt: A variable exported in before_script - is it visible in script and in after_script?

options.text: In script (same shell) but not in after_script (separate shell)

questions.explanation: before_script and script share one shell; after_script is a new one.

questions.prompt: Why npm ci rather than npm install in a pipeline?

options.text: npm ci is faster on laptops
npm ci installs exactly the lock file and fails if package.json and the lock disagree
npm install does not work in containers

questions.explanation: A reproducible install is the point of CI.

questions.prompt: stage vs stages - which statement is correct?

options.text: stages: places a job; stage: declares the order
stage: places a job in one of the stages declared by stages:

questions.explanation: stages: (top level) is the ordered list; stage: (in a job) picks one.

questions.prompt: Your test reports never appear when tests fail. Which artifacts key fixes it?
questions.explanation: Artifacts default to on_success; when: always keeps them on failure too.

questions.prompt: A job has needs: [build-api]. Does it still wait for the build stage to finish?

options.text: No - it starts as soon as build-api finishes, whatever the stage
Only if build-api is in the same stage

questions.explanation: needs: turns the pipeline into a DAG; the stage boundary no longer blocks it.

questions.prompt: A job with needs: downloads artifacts from which jobs by default?

options.text: Only jobs in the same stage

questions.explanation: needs: narrows artifact downloads to the listed jobs (artifacts: false turns one off).
